mapper.insert: insert ignore into oc_outbox_event ( event_id, dedup_key, task_id, document_version_id, task_type, task_attempt, routing_key, payload_json, trace_id, status, retry_count, max_retry_count, next_retry_time, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{eventId}, #{dedupKey}, #{taskId}, #{documentVersionId}, #{taskType}, #{taskAttempt}, #{routingKey}, #{payloadJson}, #{traceId}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{maxRetryCount}, #{nextRetryTime}, sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.update: update oc_outbox_event set event_id = #{eventId}, routing_key = #{routingKey}, payload_json = #{payloadJson}, trace_id = #{traceId}, status = '0', retry_count = 0, max_retry_count = #{maxRetryCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, last_error = null, sent_time = null, consume_status = '0', consume_error = null, consumed_time = null, completed_time = null, wait_time_ms = null, process_time_ms = null, redelivery_count = 0, dead_letter_time = null, replayed_time = null, replayed_by = null, update_time = sysdate() where dedup_key = #{dedupKey} and status = '4'
mapper.select: select outbox_id, event_id, dedup_key, task_id, document_version_id, task_type, task_attempt, routing_key, payload_json, trace_id, status, retry_count, max_retry_count, next_retry_time, last_error, sent_time, create_time, update_time from oc_outbox_event where status in ('0', '3') and retry_count < max_retry_count and next_retry_time <= sysdate() order by outbox_id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update oc_outbox_event set status = '1', update_time = sysdate() where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and status in ('0', '3') and retry_count < max_retry_count and next_retry_time <= sysdate()
update oc_outbox_event set status = '2', last_error = null, sent_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and status = '1'

update oc_outbox_event set status = '3', retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = sysdate() where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and status = '1'
update oc_outbox_event set status = '4', retry_count = #{retryCount}, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = sysdate() where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and status = '1'
update oc_outbox_event set status = '3', next_retry_time = sysdate(), last_error = '发布进程中断，已自动恢复等待重试', update_time = sysdate() where status = '1' and update_time < #{cutoffTime}
mapper.select: select outbox_id, event_id, dedup_key, task_id, document_version_id, task_type, task_attempt, routing_key, payload_json, trace_id, status, retry_count, max_retry_count, next_retry_time, last_error, sent_time, consume_status, consume_error, consumed_time, completed_time, wait_time_ms, process_time_ms, redelivery_count, dead_letter_time, replayed_time, replayed_by, create_time, update_time from oc_outbox_event where outbox_id = #{outboxId}
mapper.update: update oc_outbox_event set consume_status = '1', consumed_time = coalesce(consumed_time, sysdate()), wait_time_ms = coalesce( wait_time_ms, greatest(timestampdiff(microsecond, sent_time, sysdate()) div 1000, 0) ), redelivery_count = redelivery_count + if(#{redelivered}, 1, 0), consume_error = null, update_time = sysdate() where event_id = #{eventId} and status = '2' and consume_status in ('0', '1')

update oc_outbox_event set consume_status = '2', consume_error = null, completed_time = sysdate(), process_time_ms = greatest( timestampdiff(microsecond, consumed_time, sysdate()) div 1000, 0 ), update_time = sysdate() where event_id = #{eventId} and consume_status in ('0', '1')

update oc_outbox_event set consume_status = '3', consume_error = #{consumeError}, completed_time = sysdate(), process_time_ms = greatest( timestampdiff(microsecond, consumed_time, sysdate()) div 1000, 0 ), update_time = sysdate() where event_id = #{eventId} and consume_status in ('0', '1')

update oc_outbox_event set consume_status = '4', consume_error = #{consumeError}, completed_time = sysdate(), process_time_ms = greatest( timestampdiff(microsecond, consumed_time, sysdate()) div 1000, 0 ), update_time = sysdate() where event_id = #{eventId} and consume_status in ('0', '1', '3')
update oc_outbox_event set dead_letter_time = coalesce(dead_letter_time, sysdate()), update_time = sysdate() where event_id = #{eventId} and consume_status = '4'
mapper.sql: ( t.task_type = 'delete_index' or exists ( select 1 from oc_document d inner join oc_document_version v on v.document_version_id = t.document_version_id and v.document_id = t.document_id where d.document_id = t.document_id and d.del_flag = '0' and v.del_flag = '0' ) )
mapper.select: select (select count(1) from oc_document_task t where t.status = '0' and ) as pendingTaskCount, (select count(1) from oc_document_task t where t.status = '1' and ) as runningTaskCount, (select count(1) from oc_document_task t where t.status = '3' and ) as failedTaskCount, (select count(1) from oc_outbox_event where status = '4' or consume_status = '4') as deadLetterCount, (select coalesce(sum(greatest(attempt_count - 1, 0)), 0) from oc_document_task) as taskRetryCount, (select coalesce(sum(retry_count), 0) from oc_outbox_event) as publishRetryCount, (select coalesce(round(avg(wait_time_ms)), 0) from oc_outbox_event where wait_time_ms is not null) as averageWaitTimeMs, (select coalesce(round(avg(process_time_ms)), 0) from oc_outbox_event where process_time_ms is not null) as averageProcessTimeMs

select outbox_id as outboxId, case when status = '4' then 'PUBLISH' else 'CONSUME' end as failureStage, task_id as taskId, document_version_id as documentVersionId, task_type as taskType, task_attempt as taskAttempt, retry_count as retryCount, case when status = '4' then last_error else consume_error end as errorMessage, trace_id as traceId, coalesce(dead_letter_time, completed_time, update_time) as deadTime from oc_outbox_event where status = '4' or consume_status = '4' order by coalesce(dead_letter_time, completed_time, update_time) desc, outbox_id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update oc_outbox_event set status = '0', retry_count = 0, next_retry_time = sysdate(), last_error = null, consume_status = '0', consume_error = null, consumed_time = null, completed_time = null, wait_time_ms = null, process_time_ms = null, redelivery_count = 0, dead_letter_time = null, replayed_time = sysdate(), replayed_by = #{replayedBy}, update_time = sysdate() where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and status = '4' and consume_status = '0'

update oc_outbox_event set consume_status = '6', replayed_time = sysdate(), replayed_by = #{replayedBy}, update_time = sysdate() where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and consume_status = '4' and replayed_time is null
